title: Wisp's Postcard
feeling: Longing, a word in the path

notes.title: The pull of a place
notes.science: People grow attached to places, and that pull can bring them back long after they leave.
notes.limits: The path here is drawn by hand. Nothing in the sim walks it.
notes.counter: Some leave for good and never look back.
notes.question: What would your path spell?

sources.label: Place Attachment: How Far Have We Come in the Last 40 Years?, Lewicka, 2011
